    else:

    ext = {"": ".tar", "gz": ".tar.gz", "bz2": ".tar.bz2", "xz": ".tar.xz"}[compression]
    # Ensure the filename has the correct extension
    if not str(base).endswith(ext):
        # Strip any existing known tar extension to avoid double-extensions

                break

        archive_path = out_dir / f"{base.name}{ext}"
    else:
        archive_path = out_dir / base

    archive_path = archive_path.resolve()

    def should_exclude(p: Path) -> bool:
        abs_p = str(p)
        try:
            rel_p = str(p.relative_to(home))
        except Exception:
            rel_p = None
        for pat in patterns:
            if fnmatch.fnmatch(abs_p, pat):
                return True
            if rel_p and fnmatch.fnmatch(rel_p, pat):
                return True

        if archive_path.is_relative_to(home):
            if p.resolve() == archive_path:
                return True
        return False

    top = home.name  # top-level directory name inside archive

    with tarfile.open(archive_path, mode, dereference=False) as tf:
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(home, followlinks=False):
            root_path = Path(root)
            # Filter directories in-place to avoid descending into excluded dirs
            keep_dirs = []
            for d in dirs:
                dp = root_path / d
                if not should_exclude(dp):
                    keep_dirs.append(d)
